english: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
chinese: 将这只宝可梦，以及放于其身上的所有卡牌，放回手牌。

english: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦所使用招式的伤害「-30」。

english: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦所使用的招式的伤害「-20」。

english: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your Opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
chinese: 将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。然后，对手将其战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。

english: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
chinese: 对手将其所有的手牌放回牌库并重洗牌库。然后，对手从牌库上方抽取4张卡牌。

english: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do 50 less damage ''(before applying Weakness and Resistance)''.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦所使用招式的伤害「-50」。

english: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的'''基础'''宝可梦，无法使用招式。

english: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. ''(Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)''
chinese: 将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。然后，对手将对手自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。

english: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack ''(even if it is Knocked Out)'', put 6 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，当这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害时，将6个伤害指示物放置于使用了招式的宝可梦身上。

english: If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.
chinese: 在下一个对手的回合，受到这个招式影响的进化宝可梦，无法使用招式。

english: Knock Out your opponent's Active Pokémon. If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out in this way, this Pokémon does 200 damage to itself.
chinese: 令对手的战斗宝可梦'''{{TCG|昏厥}}'''。然后，给这只宝可梦造成200伤害。

chinese: 从自己牌库中选择1张从这只宝可梦进化而来的卡牌，放于这只宝可梦身上进行进化。并重洗牌库。
